title: CAREER PAYOUT: SCORE X2 IN CREDITS
why: His mode design and answers of 2026-10-12: in CAREER the score converts to credits you spend in the Undercroft, 1 score is 1 credit, banked only when you extract, and extraction doubles the score; CAREER keeps its own personal best board. Extracting from a CAREER raid now doubles your score and pays it into your credits, and the EXTRACTED card shows CAREER SCORE, the x2 and the credits paid. The run goes on your CAREER board (your top 10), and a new top reads CAREER BEST. Dying or abandoning pays nothing (SCORE LOST). The loot you bring out goes to your stash as items, as before, and does not count in the score.
now: Extracting from a CAREER raid pays your score x2 in credits and puts the run on your CAREER board.
